title: Phishing Redirector
author: NTT Security - Patrik Olson, Ramine Etow
description: URL pattern seen in multiple successful phishing attacks in the last few days. This phishing redirector has been observed to be deployed on compromised websites. If the user passes the antibot checks, they are redirected to a MITM phishing proxy (EvilProxy). If the phish is successful, you should see authentication attempts from the phishing proxy IP address in Azure AD / Entra ID logs.
